message.content: Logistic regression is a statistical method used for binary classification. It models the probability that a given input belongs to one of two classes by applying the logistic (sigmoid) function to a linear combination of the input features. The model parameters are typically estimated via maximum likelihood estimation, and the resulting probabilities can be thresholded to produce class predictions.
